$comment: Voice-music components (packages/audio SPEC P3.5-P3.7). Hosted at components.taalcut.app by tools/components/hosting (README.md, "Releasing components"; hosting/plan.mjs pins each source). sign-manifest.mjs drops this comment. silero-vad 6.2.3 is snakers4/silero-vad's own silero_vad.onnx at tag v6.2.3 (MIT): hosted unchanged (2327524 bytes, sha256 1a153a22f4509e292a94e67d6f9b85e8deb25b4988682b7e174c65279d8788e3); it runs on the onnxruntime component (compose-provisional.mjs adds that dependency). sfx-pack 1.0.0 is the synthesised CC0 sound pack: 32 FLAC sounds (8 whooshes, 8 risers, 8 impacts, 8 hits) made by tools/audio-packs/build-sfx-pack.mjs from FFmpeg's own generators, with catalogue.json and the CC0 dedication as LICENCE.txt. The build is reproducible (fixed seeds, bit-exact FLAC, a ustar written by the script with mtime 0, zstd 19 through Node's zlib), so the sha256 below (b5dfd368…, 1813612 bytes, extractedSize 2137415) is what any checkout's build prints, what hosting/build.mjs uploads and what the app's own extractor unpacks. The product owner approves the sounds before release. FLAC, not the Opus the SPEC planned: the shipped LGPL FFmpeg has no libopus and its native Opus encoder is experimental. kind is model because the schema has no data kind. music-pack is not here: its track list (tools/audio-packs/music-tracks.json) is empty until the product owner picks the CC0 tracks, and build-music-pack.mjs refuses an empty list; the app hides the option meanwhile (audio.music_library_empty).
